title: Atlas V Centaur upper stage (LCROSS impactor)
credit: Echoes of Exploration team (modelled in code from NASA reference drawings and photos)
note: Single-engine Atlas V Centaur as it hit Cabeus crater in 2009: 12.68 m long and 3.05 m across. RL10A-4-2 engine (dark lower nozzle, tube-wall upper nozzle, turbopumps, gimbal actuators) under the oxygen tank's aft dome, with helium and hydrazine bottles and four thruster pods; the white-painted steel balloon tank (oxygen below, hydrogen above) with hydrogen feed line, vent line and wiring tunnel; forward adapter ring with avionics boxes; and the open payload-adapter cone that carried LCROSS. Simplified: bottle count and box layout are representative.
